changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE deployers ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE, kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('core', 'worker')), key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), created_by INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL, version VARCHAR(40) NULL );
